---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible defect
title: '[Bug] '
labels: 'type:bug'
---

## Expected and observed behavior

Describe the expected result and what actually happened, including the error text with sensitive details removed.

## Versions and installation channel

Record Python/OS, exact distribution versions and whether this is a source checkout or delivered wheel/sdist. Link the relevant numbered story if one exists.

## Minimal synthetic reproduction

Include the smallest runnable supplied-data example and its actual output. Use synthetic or explicitly licensed inputs and explain the expected numerical result, units/timing and null handling when relevant. Do not include credentials, proprietary data or code without redistribution rights.

## Checks and routing

List the commands actually run, their results and limitations. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/atulsrivas1/equity-features/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for source setup, relevant checks and the best-effort support target. Identify whether the issue belongs to the core, optional I/O or workers; account administration stays with the setup owner.

For a security report, follow [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/atulsrivas1/equity-features/blob/main/SECURITY.md) and request a private channel without disclosing sensitive details publicly. This template does not assert that private vulnerability reporting is enabled.
